posts.title: Building a URL shortener designed for 1.2M requests per second
posts.description: I have been brushing up on my system design skills and I thought to myself “what if I just build a URL shortener myself?”. So I did and the result is on GitHub ! I translated the classic interview-style system design question from something abstract into something concrete. With a coding agent this was feasible in a short amount of time.

posts.title: My first impressions of n8n
posts.description: I recently tried n8n for the first time. In this article, I share my first impressions after building a workflow with it in a few hours.

posts.title: Learning material – software development
posts.description: In this article, I share the learning resources that I have used to teach myself software development since early 2015. I cover fundamentals, Java, SQL, JavaScript, React, Docker, Rails, Android, iOS, best practices, Vim and more.
